answer: Stop sybils with a meadow onyx signal: an agent bonds one meadow plot. Each cycle it buries one onyx pebble and strikes it; verifiers match the signal ring to the plot chart, voiding a copied or twice-claimed pebble, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 meadows at 17x: one pebble rings once in one meadow, its tone set by that soil, unreplayable for a second, cannot be copied, shared or bulk-bought. Honest agents bury once, keep rights.
